notes: SqueekChain is an ERC-20 token with symbol SQK and 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 SQK once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers have no tax or burn. There are no application contracts or privileged administrative functions. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
